product_metadata.title: Ohara Insulated Easy Zip Lock Resealable Aluminum Sandwich Bag - Reusable Thermal Snack Bento Camping Picnic Hot & Cold Pouch (Sliver, 10)
features: KEEP FOOD AT DESIRED TEMPERATURE FOR HOURS – These hot cold bags are an ideal solution to keep your warm food warm and cold food cold for hours, be it seafood, fruits, drinks, milk, sandwiches, pizza, salads or other things. Whether you want to go for beach picnic or just want to carry your groceries, these bags prove to be good companion. Moreover, the bags are extremely durable yet inexpensive!
FOOD SAFE REUSABLE BAGS – Our insulated thermal bags are made up of Aluminum film, Foam Paper, which are all food-safe. They are lightweight, moisture proof, shock proof and thermal insulation.

ZIP LOCK - The Zip Lock offered by the bag ensures that your food is certainly kept at the desired temperature and as fresh as you would want it to be. (If you put the ice pack in the bag, the effect of heat insulation or cooling will be maximized.)
Portable : It’s easy to bring at anywhere
